name: @socio/site
description: Socio's public site (socio.sh): static pages built with Vite and Tailwind, served by a Cloudflare Worker with static assets. The store-facing privacy, terms, cookies, delete-account and support pages live here.

scripts.dev: pnpm run build && cross-env WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false DO_NOT_TRACK=1 WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler dev --local
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -w exec tsc -p apps/site/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm -w exec tsc -p apps/site/tsconfig.build.json --noEmit
